'''Metron Besk''' was the founder of [[Dynamic Automata]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-manufacturing company. Besk built the company from a single firm that supplied logic-enhancement circuits to third-degree droids. Eventually, he began supplying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] with advanced droid circuitry aboard [[Sector Plexus/Legends|Sector Plexus]] droid vessels and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]].

Besk was a suspicious man and grew tired of the backstabbing and bickering among his company's partners. Before his [[Death/Legends|death]], Besk carefully divided the company's power among them so that they would all have to answer to his daughter, [[Elta Besk]]. Besk trained his daughter in corporate and armed warfare and handed control of Dynamic Automata over to her.
